title: Recapitulating the Binding Affinity of Nrf2 for KEAP1 in a Cyclic Heptapeptide, Guided by NMR, X-ray Crystallography, and Machine Learning.
authors: Ortet, Paula C; Muellers, Samantha N; Viarengo-Baker, Lauren A; Streu, Kristina; Szymczyna, Blair R; Beeler, Aaron B; Allen, Karen N; Whitty, Adrian
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合NMR、X射线晶体学和机器学习，优化环肽以模拟Nrf2与KEAP1的结合亲和力，属于蛋白质-肽互作而非典型TF-DNA体系，但机器学习分析结合构象应变的方法对蛋白-核酸互作建模有借鉴意义。
abstract: Macrocycles, including macrocyclic peptides, have shown promise for targeting challenging protein-protein interactions (PPIs). One PPI of high interest is between Kelch-like ECH-Associated Protein-1 (KEAP1) and Nuclear Factor (Erythroid-derived 2)-like 2 (Nrf2). Guided by X-ray crystallography, NMR, modeling, and machine learning, we show that the full 20 nM binding affinity of Nrf2 for KEAP1 can be recapitulated in a cyclic 7-mer peptide, c[(D)-beta-homoAla-DPETGE]. This compound was identified from the Nrf2-derived linear peptide GDEETGE (K(D) = 4.3 muM) solely by optimizing the conformation of the cyclic compound, without changing any KEAP1 interacting residue. X-ray crystal structures were determined for each linear and cyclic peptide variant bound to KEAP1. Despite large variations in affinity, no obvious differences in the conformation of the peptide binding residues or in the interactions they made with KEAP1 were observed. However, analysis of the X-ray structures by machine learning showed that locations of strain in the bound ligand could be identified through patterns of subangstrom distortions from the geometry observed for unstrained linear peptides. We show that optimizing the cyclic peptide affinity was driven partly through conformational preorganization associated with a proline substitution at position 78 and with the geometry of the noninteracting residue Asp77 and partly by decreasing strain in the ETGE motif itself. This approach may have utility in dissecting the trade-off between conformational preorganization and strain in other ligand-receptor systems. We also identify a pair of conserved hydrophobic residues flanking the core DxETGE motif which play a conformational role in facilitating the high-affinity binding of Nrf2 to KEAP1.
abstract_zh: 大环化合物，包括大环肽，在靶向具有挑战性的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）方面显示出潜力。一个高度关注的PPI是Kelch样ECH相关蛋白-1（KEAP1）与核因子（红细胞衍生2）样2（Nrf2）之间的相互作用。在X射线晶体学、核磁共振（NMR）、建模和机器学习的指导下，我们表明Nrf2对KEAP1的完整20 nM结合亲和力可以在环状7-mer肽c[(D)-beta-homoAla-DPETGE]中重现。该化合物是从Nrf2衍生的线性肽GDEETGE（K(D) = 4.3 muM）中仅通过优化环状化合物的构象而鉴定出来的，未改变任何KEAP1相互作用残基。我们确定了每个线性和环状肽变体与KEAP1结合的X射线晶体结构。尽管亲和力存在巨大差异，但在肽结合残基的构象或它们与KEAP1的相互作用中未观察到明显差异。然而，通过机器学习对X射线结构的分析表明，结合配体中的应变位置可以通过与无应变线性肽观察到的几何结构的亚埃级畸变模式来识别。我们表明，优化环状肽亲和力部分由与脯氨酸替代在位置78及非相互作用残基Asp77的几何结构相关的构象预组织驱动，部分通过减少ETGE基序本身的应变实现。这种方法可能有助于剖析其他配体-受体系统中构象预组织与应变之间的权衡。我们还识别出一对保守的疏水残基，它们侧翼于核心DxETGE基序，在促进Nrf2与KEAP1高亲和力结合中发挥构象作用。
